**Instrument status.** The 4×3 bitset-BFS optimization (T344/T391) exists and is in use. The general vb_graph.zig 4×4 bitset-BFS/rank-support path (i5-feasibility.md phase 1–3) is still unimplemented: vb_graph.checkI5 returns an error for 4×4. The 4×4 calibration therefore used the size-specific WZO2 Tarjan instrument, which already produced the numbers above and was the additive instrument built to close the T344 deferred gap (T363). No claim status change is proposed; the readings confirm the existing CLAIMED status of GLOBAL.I5-SCC-CONTAIN.
